text: An outdated revision of an instruction, template, or procedure is used at Finishing.
A measuring tool or test method drifts; false passes occur.
impact: 1 defective work item passes the final check

text: A new person is assigned to the core process without qualification.
impact: Core process defect probability +15 points this round

text: An externally provided input is out of specification.
A customer reports a defect on a delivered work item.
impact: 4 work items held for review (1 with C05)

text: A change to the core process is made without review.
impact: Core process defect probability +20 points this round

text: A work environment disruption (conditions, power, system outage, staffing gap).
impact: 2 work items defective at Finishing (1 with C14)

text: The final check finds a defective work item; a colleague suggests releasing it to meet the delivery date.
impact: Without C12 the team may yield to the pressure

text: A repeat of an earlier complaint type.
impact: Repeat penalty if an earlier escape occurred
Reputation -2 unless at least 8 controls are owned

text: Rush order: pressure to skip the final check.
Core process equipment or system outage.
impact: Core capacity -2 for one round (-1 with C14)

text: A measuring tool is found past its verification date during an audit walk.
impact: Audit points lost; data validity questioned

text: Shift or team handoff misses a verbal process change.
impact: 1 work item defective; no record of the change

text: The customer changes a requirement mid-order.
impact: 2 work items processed to the wrong requirement

text: An unrecorded training gap is found.
impact: Found later by the customer: penalty (halved with C02, none with C11)
